source: Original procedural task-space choreography; not mocap.
coordinateSystem: +Y up, +Z forward, character left +X; 1m reference hip height
limitations: No target-Claude/eidoverse engine render test here.
Reference contact checks are ankle anchors, not sole or collision simulation.
No finger, face, lipsync or costume tracks.
Song cues retain the supplied line intervals; word alignment and pulse phase are provisional.

groups.label: P-doom / signature chorus
groups.description: Unison hook, mirrored expansion, fan-facing heart motif and a returning chorus.

groups.label: Mirror battle / two wings
groups.description: Left and right wings answer symmetrically around an unmirrored centre.

groups.label: Paperclip assembly / ripple
groups.description: A quarter-beat hand ripple crosses the group, reverses, then becomes a fuse relay.

groups.label: Training run / loss cascade
groups.description: Robot shapes become a staggered drop, accelerating arms and a simultaneous burst.

groups.label: Forward pass / backward pass
groups.description: A shared forward/back phrase, reverse hand ripple and group quarter-turn.

groups.label: Recursive upgrade relay
groups.description: Half-beat propagation builds the copy-and-amplify silhouette.

groups.label: Individual spotlights / backing groove
groups.description: Different dancers take a solo while the others keep a restrained mechanical backing phrase.

groups.label: Frame the centre / plea and release
groups.description: Backing dancers frame the front-centre lyric performance.

groups.label: Expanding V / travelling steps
groups.description: The V expands and contracts on baked alternating steps, not sliding scene containers.

groups.label: GPU finale / extended ensemble
groups.description: A 64-beat finale with a chorus, robot contrast, ripple, barrier break and ending pose.

song.alignment: Supplied line boundaries only. Phrase starts are line-cued, not individual words. Raw transcript errors remain.
